summary: Correct, minimal guard for the documented crash: cursor.fetchone() can return None (no rows to cull) and is now checked before subscripting, exactly matching the bug report's root cause. The only oddity is a no-op hunk on clear()'s DELETE line (likely a whitespace/line-ending artifact), which is harmless.

issues.description: The clear() hunk replaces 'DELETE FROM %s' with an identical line — an unrelated no-op edit (probably trailing-whitespace/EOL artifact). Cosmetic, not blocking, but ideally dropped to keep the diff to the cull fix only.
